set.body: Prerequisite for Root eco-u5-core. Move Placed/Rebind and sealed point/vector FrameOwned evidence to neuroim4s-spaces using spatial4s directly. GridSpec packaging stays core through checked alignment and singleton packaging; do not unseal witnesses or add unsafe casts/forged owner evidence. Preserve wide-static-frame and persistent-world refusals, bindTo owner/lifetime checks and compile-time capture probes. Tests and docs move with the actual owner; optional reframe map composition stays downstream. Acceptance: spaces/core JVM+JS and actual IO/consumer qualification with independent review.
set.title: Separate world placement contracts from grid ownership admission
